FN-RJ6KMNM-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 126
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Wilcox
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 126 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Board of Midwifery until
October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or
local funding.
Page 1
